timeRangeHistogram.description: A controlled stacked histogram for selecting and moving a bucket-aligned time range with pointer or keyboard input.
timeRangeHistogram.instruction: Drag the selection to move the range
timeRangeHistogram.behaviorPointer: Drag outside the active selection to create a new range. Drag inside it to move the range without changing its duration.
timeRangeHistogram.behaviorKeyboard: Use Arrow keys to move one bucket, Page Up or Page Down to move five buckets, and Home or End to reach either boundary.
timeRangeHistogram.behaviorData: The component visualizes already aggregated buckets. Filtering and server-side aggregation remain the responsibility of the consuming feature.
timeRangeHistogram.p0: Accessible name for the interactive range selector.
timeRangeHistogram.p1: Ordered, non-overlapping buckets with start, end, label, and series values.
timeRangeHistogram.p2: Series keys, labels, active colors, and optional inactive colors.
timeRangeHistogram.p3: Controlled start and end timestamps for the selected range.
timeRangeHistogram.p4: Called when pointer or keyboard interaction commits a new bucket-aligned range.
timeRangeHistogram.p5: Formats the selected range announced by assistive technology.
timeRangeHistogram.p6: Formats each series value in the tooltip.
timeRangeHistogram.p7: Overrides the label beneath the first bucket.
timeRangeHistogram.p8: Overrides the label beneath the last bucket.
timeRangeHistogram.p9: Optional visible pointer and keyboard interaction hint.
timeRangeHistogram.p10: Content rendered when data contains no buckets.
timeRangeHistogram.p11: Disables pointer and keyboard selection without hiding the histogram.
timeRangeHistogram.p12: Class applied to the fixed-height chart container.
